He is sensitive to the smell of disinfectant and hates verbal reports. He takes pressure to accept unverified medicine as an insult.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Clinic disinfection records
- Rank: Duty Chief
- Title: Clinic Duty at Gayang 2-dong
**Life.** Born in the 2126 generation. Grew up beside the Gayang 2-dong clinic. The post of Duty Chief opened through bypassing the heating line and keeping the examination room warm in midwinter.
- Workplace: Gayang 2-dong. At the Gayang 2-dong clinic, Bak Nuri seals the instrument disinfection record every shift and, when medicine stock falls short of the standard, holds back and refuses medicine brought in from outside.

**Office.** Rank: Duty Chief. Title: Clinic Duty at Gayang 2-dong. Every shift he seals and keeps the disinfection record, and if standards are not met he does not put instruments in the examination room even when pressed.

**Anecdote.** In midwinter, instead of thawing the frozen heating line, he laid a bypass wiring and kept the examination room warm. Because of this, his signature for the clinic Duty Chief post was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** He cross-checks disinfection records with the duty staff of neighboring clinics and hides no medicine stock from the doctors.

**Ambition.** To bind the disinfection and stock-check cycles of the clinics in the Gayang area into one public checklist and protect instruments the doctors can trust.

**Fear.** That patients increase before it is known that medicine has run out, reducing the clinic's function itself to a bargaining chip.

**Intervention.** He can escort the sealed samples to Magok to justify his lock decision, or track down whoever swapped the samples and put his supervisorship at risk.

rules.from:
Gentle by nature, but she stops compromising the moment household-level rations are cut off. She hears any suggestion to sacrifice one alley for efficiency as an insult.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Occupation: Food waiting-ticket management
- Rank: District Head
- Title: Food Distribution Handler at Sinjeong 2-dong
**Life.** Generation of 2126. He grew up beside the alley storehouse in Sinjeong 2-dong. His seat as food distribution handler opened through counting the alley storehouse stock to the very end on a midwinter night.
- Workplace: Sinjeong 2-dong. In the alleys of Sinjeong 2-dong, Im Bada posts the household food waiting tickets. When a stock shortage is announced, he gathers the residents' representatives' confirmations to demand the opening of the storehouse, and seeks cooperation from the other District Chief at the same station.

**Office.** Rank: District Chief. Title: Food Distribution Handler at Sinjeong 2-dong. He publicly posts the food waiting tickets for each alley, and when a stock shortage is announced, he demands the opening of the storehouse by gathering the residents' representatives' confirmations.

**Anecdote.** In midwinter, Im Bada counted the grain and fuel remaining in the Sinjeong-dong alley storehouse and spent the whole night setting minimum per-household amounts with the residents' representatives.

**Relations.** He aligns the order of food distribution with neighboring area handlers, harbors a deep grievance over one-sided halts to removals on grounds of stock shortage, and defers to the other District Chief at the same station as if to a guardian.

**Ambition.** To nail down in the area's rules a principle that leaves a minimum food line for every household even as winter food shrinks.

**Fear.** That evacuated residents will remain only as figures in food counts and be pushed off the waiting roster.

**Intervention.** You can measure the alleys short of food and enforce the minimum line, or expose the tampering with the waiting tickets and strip him of his standing as handler.

Fills the blanks in the timetable before any person can, and ruthlessly pulls engineers who hide the reasons for delays off the dispatch. Cannot tolerate orders that push food trains back according to political rank.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Rail dispatching
- Rank: Jusa (Clerk)
- Title: Sinjeong Depot Rail Toll Dispatcher
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Grew up at the Sinjeong rail depot. The post of Sinjeong Depot Rail Toll Dispatcher opened through a defect report filed just before a derailment.
- Workplace: Sinjeong 3-dong. On the dispatch board at the Sinjeong 3-dong depot, Yu Sejin writes the order of food, maintenance and fuel, and notifies the maintenance desk of the departure time after brake repairs.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Dispatcher at the Sinjeong 3-dong Depot. She writes the dispatch order on a public blackboard, but the dispatcher re-declares the order of food, maintenance and fuel every day, and punishes bribed dispatching by blocking the tracks.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, repaired a failed brake through the night and saved the dispatch for the next shift change. Because of this, the signature for the post of Sinjeong Depot Rail Toll Dispatcher was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** Maintains the Western Relay Dispatch Contract with Bak Taegyeom, sends wheel-replacement apprentices to Yi Hongwon, and vouches on the dispatch board for the departure of Choe Hangyeol's maintenance trains.

**Ambition.** Reorganize western train dispatch around priority for food trains, so that food does not stall on the tracks even in winter.

**Fear.** That if the passage on the Yongsan side is blocked, the Sinjeong sidings will fill up and maintenance trains and food trains will be trapped at the same time.

**Intervention.** Can obtain a bypass track permit to let food trains through, or expose the private embezzlement of emergency dispatch shares.

She hears the echo on the tunnel wall before she hears footsteps, and treats leaking night light as a danger sign rather than a mistake. When a colleague's shift slips, she walks the snowy path first herself.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Occupation: Tunnel patrol
- Rank: Clerk
- Title: Yeongdeungpo Tunnel Patroller
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Raised at the Amsa post. The tunnel patrol post came to her after she held an outsider who had lit a lamp outside the gate on a midwinter night.
- Work location: Dangsan 2-dong. At the tunnel entrance under the Dangsan 2-dong bridge, Chae Ongyeol writes the patrol times on the board and first checks the alleys where kidnapping rumors have spread and the vents where light leaks.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Yeongdeungpo Tunnel Patroller. She writes patrol times on the public board, but lets the night entrances be opened only with the light covered.

**Anecdote.** In the winter of 2125 she stopped an armed gang trying to drag people away outside the gate and had the residents' roster rechecked. Because of this, her signature for the tunnel patrol post was entered in the ledger.

**Relations.** She redeploys patrols together with the other shift patrollers and prioritizes guarding the alleys where kidnapping rumors have spread.

**Ambition.** To bind the Yeongdeungpo tunnel and under-bridge patrols into a single night signal system, becoming the backbone of the free city's night watch.

**Fear.** One tunnel being blocked and people trapped, and outside machines coming through that gap, drawn by light and heat.

**Intervention.** You can trace the source of the kidnapping rumor and have the patrol line withdrawn, or hand over the signal leak and have the patrol deployment changed.

rules.from:
If the knot in the sealing cord is loose, he refuses to depart, and he treats an envoy who does not record oral messages as someone likely carrying forgeries. Even out of breath, he holds both copies in one hand.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Occupation: Contract dispatch delivery
- Rank: Clerk
- Title: Yangpyeong Passage Courier
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Raised in an underground dwelling in Yeongdeungpo. He took the passage courier post after carrying a lost dispatch in its place on the first cold night. Daniel Brooks was born in 2089 and grew up in a Yeongdeungpo dwelling. He learned the English of an African American family line at home and carries dispatches in Korean. As a passage courier of the free city he delivers sealed messages, and for neighbors who struggle with the language he has a person read the dispatch aloud to confirm it. Daniel's ancestor Samuel Brooks was handling U.S. Army supply work in Yongsan-Itaewon in 2026 when the communication network broke down. The family passed its records of shelter and goods handovers to the next generation, and Daniel Brooks's parents' generation cross-checked those records against the living ledgers of their own day. After his birth in 2089, Daniel compared those ledgers once more against the records of the Yeongdeungpo dwelling.
- Work location: Yangpyeong 1-dong. At the Yangpyeong 1-dong passage junction, Daniel Brooks sends sealed dispatches separately to two dwellings, and sets aside the spoken message to be passed to Itaewon 1-dong and memorizes it once more.
- Work location: Itaewon 1-dong. On the language-pair duty at the Itaewon Interpreter Gate, Daniel Brooks has a person read the ratification sentence aloud and separately hands over the sealed copy from the Yangpyeong 1-dong contract courier.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Yangpyeong Passage Courier. He informs the receiving dwelling and the sending dwelling at the same time, and a danger warning goes out only when it bears both the sender's seal and the verifier's signature.

**Anecdote.** On a midwinter night a warning bearing only one seal arrives in the courier's bag. Daniel Brooks first runs to a nearby dwelling to obtain the verifying signature, and he carries the other dispatches in the same bag with their seals verified.

**Relations.** His is a contract to deliver Jang Pilgyu's audit wording on site; he carries Han Jaemok's protection-rights expansion proposal only under seal, and he weighs each time whether to hand Yun Seorin a copy of the ratification.

**Ambition.** By having every warning dispatch in the city entered on the courier ledger he himself seals, he becomes the mouth of the free city's passages.

**Fear.** The fear that a single forged warning dispatch will drive people out all at once and cause the courier network to lose all trust.

**Intervention.** You can find the forged dispatch and protect his seal, or expose the held document in the bag and neutralize the expansion proposal.

Sensitive to the smell of fuel and hates verbal power allocations. Takes the pressure to divert power from dwelling heating to the wharf lighting as an insult.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Occupation: Emergency generator operation
- Rank: Duty Captain
- Title: Chief Emergency Generator Operator, Sinjeong Depot
**Life.** Born in the 2126 generation. Grew up at the Sinjeong rail depot. The post of Chief Emergency Generator Operator at Sinjeong Depot opened after a defect report filed just before a derailment.
- Workplace: Sinjeong 3-dong. At the Sinjeong 3-dong depot, Chae Hansol seals the fuel-reserve and output logs and sends them to Heo Eunchan, and allocates emergency generator output to match Heo Dodam's pump test runs.

**Office.** Rank of Duty Chief. Title: Emergency Generator Operations Duty, Sinjeong Depot. Every shift she seals the fuel-reserve and output logs and posts them on the public gauge board, and if output falls below the minimum she cuts repair power distribution whatever favor is asked.

**Anecdote.** In 2125 he repaired a broken brake through the night and kept the next shift's dispatch on schedule. For this, his signature for the post of Chief Emergency Generator Operator, Sinjeong Depot, went into the ledger.

**Relations.** He backs Heo Eunchan's siding power allocation from the generation side, matches output to Heo Dodam's pump test runs, and has obeyed Han Jaemok's orders to maintain supply but has refused concealed power distribution.

**Ambition.** To bind Sinjeong emergency power and Yeongdeungpo heating power into a single public distribution grid and protect the warmth of the winter dwellings.

**Fear.** A night when the fuel runs out, heating runs only on hand-fed stoves, and the glow of the embers draws outside machines.

**Intervention.** You can obtain substitute fuel to open dual distribution, or expose the tampering with the output logs and replace the operator.

rules.from:
Taciturn, he remembers people by the tolerance of their fingertips. He sees improvised modifications that are not in the specification not as talent but as seeds of accidents.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Pump maintenance and measurement
- Rank: Ordinary Citizen
- Title: Cheonwang Base Fabrication Elder
**Life.** Born in the 2126 generation. Grew up in the Sinjeong Rail Depot. The post of Cheonwang Base Fabrication Elder opened after a defect report filed just before a derailment.
- Work location: Oryu 2-dong. At the Cheonwang Base in Oryu 2-dong, Jeong Siu measures the worn shaft of a stalled pump and matches it to the drawings. Until the measurement seal is stamped, he does not open that part's shipment slot on Pyo Yedam's siding dispatch board, and he sends the specification revision record to Jang Useok.

**Office.** Rank: Ordinary Citizen. Title: Cheonwang Base Fabrication Elder. He stamps a measurement seal on every part shipped, and modified parts without a seal are not admitted to the Cheonwang siding.

**Anecdote.** In 2125 he disassembled a stalled pump, ground down just one worn shaft, and got it running again. Because of this, his signature for the post of Cheonwang Base Fabrication Elder was entered in the ledger.

**Relations.** He is close to a master-and-disciple relationship with Gang Minseo in matters of standards, is in a wheel alliance with Choe Hangyeol, the free city's Train Chief, and permits no revision of standards without Jang Useok's record seal.

**Ambition.** To fix the compatibility table for wheel and pump screws across all of Seoul into a single Cheonwang ledger, forming the backbone of the Workshop Production Guild.

**Fear.** That the Guard Corps will cut military-only screws separately, leaving the civilian repair network incompatible overnight.

**Intervention.** By bringing in the measured tolerances of a sealed screw, one can break the Elder's seal, or by finding the hidden drawings of a screw made exclusively for military use, one can expose the split in the standards.

She enjoys practical gain, but never makes the safety of roofs and main power lines a bargaining chip. She long remembers anyone who looks down on residents' votes compared with skilled workers.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Occupation: Waiting-hall duty
- Rank: Director
- Title: Guro Building Guild Representative
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Raised on waiting-hall duty. The post of Guro Building Guild Representative opened through a substitute duty after an unexcused shift absence.
- Work location: Guro 3-dong. Bak So-eon gathers the Guro 3-dong Building Guild's roof and residential power repair applications and discloses the lottery order. If a demand comes to divert hands to one side first, she separately records the materials the next shift will use, then checks the fuel ledger to set the work order of the assigned workshops.

**Office.** Rank: Director. Title: Guro Building Guild Representative. Power equipment and pump installations are put out to open bidding building by building, and the winning workshop must share its skill scores with the labor union.

**Anecdote.** In 2125 she spent a night negotiating terms with a slowdown work crew and opened the next shift. For this, her signature for the post of Guro Building Guild Representative was entered in the ledger.

**Relations.** She is an ally who supports the workshop guild's work division from the building side, matches ledgers with the food guild's fuel tables, and clashes whenever pulling repair hands away delays roof construction.

**Ambition.** Fix the repair order of workshop buildings and residential shells by guild lottery, so that munitions work crews cannot seize residential power first.

**Fear.** That once the winter fuel reserve runs out and building heating goes cold, guild members become hostages of whoever holds the fuel.

**Intervention.** She can obtain replacement stove parts to break the seal, or expose the bid-rigging ledger to reopen the guild lottery.

Principled, and hates blanks in a sentence. He calls elders who do not enter verbally agreed compatibility into the ledger enemies of the standards.

- Affiliation: Unaffiliated (formerly Daejeon Bloc; power shift 2026-10-22)
- Livelihood: Standards recording and auditing
- Rank: Guild Member
- Title: Repair Standards Audit Recorder
**Life.** Born in the generation of 2126. Raised at the Seoul Station registry office. The post of Repair Standards Audit Recorder opened after a single line was deleted from a double ledger.
- Jang Useok, raised at the Seoul Station registry office, sends standards copies to both the Guild Council and the workshops from the audit window at Cheonwang. He reverses emergency revisions made without remeasurement by attaching a three-day deadline, and cross-checks Jeong Siu's measurement seal. His former superior is preserved as Min Ungi. The Daejeon Jung-gu holding claim was dissolved by the power shift of 2026-10-22.
- Residence and work location: Resides within the Oryu 2-dong administrative district and works at the daily-supply cargo handover and rationing window in the Cheonwang Station concourse. This grants no housing or bed rights and no exclusive occupancy, and it is not a Seoul title or holding grant or a confirmation of landlessness.

**Office.** Rank: Guild Member. Title: Repair Standards Audit Recorder. He distributes standards copies to the Guild Council and the workshops at the same time, and insists that even an emergency revision is void without remeasurement within three days.

**Anecdote.** A standards revision citing a military-supply emergency circulates among the workshops first, with no remeasurement record. Jang Useok attaches an audit clause stating the three-day deadline, reissues the standards copies to the Guild Council and the workshops simultaneously, and begins by cross-checking Jeong Siu's measurement seal.

**Relationships.** A contract to verify Jeong Siu's measurement seal; he consults Jeong Yura's termination-condition sentences and seeks to push I Gangmuk's cipher-mobilization notebook out of the ledger.

**Ambition.** He wants every standards revision to carry an audit seal and a termination condition, so that standards do not vanish under the pretext of a military-supply emergency.

**Fear.** The fear that a single forged measurement seal will void the entire Cheonwang ledger and split the standards system into parts blockades.

**Intervention.** He can trace the manufacturing workshop of a defective part, or catch whoever forged an audit seal, to establish the Recorder's authority.

**Office.** Rank: Director. Title: Protective Suit Guild Representative. Writes shipment quantities on the guild blackboard, and allows military priority allocation only when the disaster-prevention samples exceed the standard.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, when the accounts of two witnesses diverged, convened a public confrontation. Because of this, the signature for the post of Protective Suit Guild Representative was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** Shares filter performance verification as an ally with Choe Eunjae, the Magok certifier; takes charge of the protection process in Gang Minseo's process division; and competes over raw material exchange with Han Somi's leather workshop.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Workshop Medical Care and Neural-Link Surgery
- Rank: Guild Member
- Title: Geumcheon Workshop Neurosurgeon
**Life.** Born into the 2126 generation. Raised at the Jegi-dong infirmary. The post of Geumcheon Workshop Medic opened up through the discovery of a fake medicine seal.
- Work location: Gasan-dong. On Gasan-dong workshop clinic duty, Jin Uram checks the protective-suit filter numbers of dust patients. If Im Chaewon's dispatch slip and Choe Eunjae's certification stamp do not match, they hold that lot, and they record the number of medical meals served on days when Han Jion's ration pot is empty.

**Office.** Rank: union member. Title: Geumcheon Workshop Medic. Writes the number of patients treated and filter dispatches on the same blackboard, and allows priority allocation to the quartermaster only when the disaster-prevention sample exceeds the threshold.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, during a medicine shortage, they halved the prescribed amounts and shared them out to everyone. Because of this, the signature for the post of Geumcheon Workshop Medic went into the ledger.

**Relations.** Close to a disciple who applies Im Chaewon's filter standards to treatment, opens a medical meal service when Han Jion's ration pot runs empty, and locks dispatch when Choe Eunjae's filter certification stamp is missing.

**Ambition.** Gets protective filters and workshop care to all workshop hands, so that they can breathe even in winter dust.

**Fear.** The filter fabric piling up in only one place, leaving the Geumcheon work crews abandoned in dust and cold.

**Intervention.** Can find substitute fabric, or expose the filters hidden in the quartermaster warehouse to turn the direction of the vote.

Suspects the blanks in the sabotage list before the rust on the barrier gates, and does not lower the gun in front of the tool warehouse even when debates drag on. Takes responsibility for subordinates' family rations, but does not read delay on the union side as betrayal.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Occupation: Workshop patrol
- Rank: Union member
- Title: Guro Workshop Patrol Squad Leader
**Life.** Born into the 2126 generation. Raised at the Amsa guard post. The post of Guro Workshop Patrol Squad Leader opened up after catching an unauthorized night river crossing.
- Work location: Guro 2-dong. Chae Riul posts a winter barrier-gate shift table on the patrol route between the Guro 2-dong workshops. While taking I Gangmuk's barrier-gate command, under the contract to protect Kim Nayul's citizenship register, they route anything beyond tool removal to Gu Chansol as records.

**Office.** Rank: union member. Title: Guro Workshop Patrol Squad Leader. Makes daytime patrol routes public, but follows night armed drafts only when both Kim Nayul's register and I Gangmuk's passcode are present.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, when the first report turned out wrong during a bridge-raid drill, they reopened the observation car. Because of this, the signature for the post of Guro Workshop Patrol Squad Leader went into the ledger.

**Relations.** A dual contract of taking command of the barrier gates from I Gangmuk while protecting Kim Nayul's citizenship register, and backing Gu Chansol's blockade of tool removal with patrols.

**Ambition.** Binds workshop patrols under the seal of the Guild Council, so that the guard corps cannot lock in striking workshops.

**Fear.** The labor union halting parts dispatch, leaving the patrol guarding only empty barrier gates until it is broken through by raiders from the outskirts.

**Intervention.** Can justify their dual contract by helping to stop the raids from the outskirts, or hand a secret weapons production notebook to the Guild Council to have the squad leader replaced.

He memorizes the measurement figures on the standards copies, and calls any elder who does not enter a verbally agreed compatibility into the ledger an enemy of the standard. When the sealing cord gets wet, he sets out again.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Delivering standards documents
- Rank: Guild Member
- Title: Manufacturing Standards Courier
**Life.** Born in the generation of 2126. Grew up on the Sinnae Transfer watch. The Manufacturing Standards Courier post opened up after he stopped a ticketless departing train.
- Workplace: Guro 5-dong. Pyo Gangho counts the seal numbers on the standards copies he will take to the Guro 5-dong Guild Council. If Jang Useok's audit seal and Jeong Siu's measuring seal do not match, he does not unseal the copy of Kang Minseo's exchange design and sends the confirmation dispatch back.

**Office.** Rank: Guild Member. Title: Manufacturing Standards Courier. He delivers standards copies to the guild council and the workshops at the same time, and does not run even an emergency revision unless a re-measurement notice has come within three days.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, he was caught in a raid during an escort and secured the ledger of persons before the cargo. Because of this, the signature for the Manufacturing Standards Courier post was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** He holds a contract to deliver Jang Useok's audit seals on site, protects Jeong Siu's measuring seals with verification dispatches, and carries Kang Minseo's exchange designs only while they remain sealed.

**Ambition.** To post every change notice for the workshops' repair order on a single board, so that the order cannot be quietly changed under the pretext of a winter emergency.

**Fear.** A single forged measuring seal invalidating the entire Cheonwang ledger, turning the courier network into a bugle call for a parts blockade.

**Intervention.** He can track the workshop that made a defective part, or catch whoever forged a dispatch seal and bring the courier network to a halt.

rules.from:
Reads cracks in the sleepers to tell whether a detour is possible, and hates orders to leave a finished blocking gate open for political bargaining. Bold and quick-handed.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Waiting-hall duty
- Rank: Guild member
- Title: Southwest Outer Track Surveyor
**Life.** Born in the 2126 cohort. Raised on waiting-hall duty. The post of Southwest Outer Track Surveyor opened through a substitute shift covering an unexcused absence.
- Workplace: Oryu 2-dong. At Oryu 2-dong, Myeong Soi marks the southwest track sleepers heaved up by winter ice and enters them in the survey log. Before Heo Daon's wheel trial run passes, Myeong Soi tells Choe Dain the section to be replaced, and gives Han Jion's ration cart only the detour inside Seoul.

**Office.** Rank: Guild member. Title: Southwest Outer Track Surveyor. Posts track repairs publicly on the day shift, and follows night armed surveys only when they bear the seal of the Guild Council.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, when the accounts of two witnesses diverged, held a public confrontation. Because of this, the signature for the post of Southwest Outer Track Surveyor entered the ledger.

**Relations.** Bound to Choe Dain as empty-car mentor and apprentice, sharing the outer-track laying; swaps in sleepers to match Heo Daon's wheel trial run; and guides Han Jion's procurement column along the detour.

**Ambition.** To build a survey ledger of the outer track's sleeper conditions walked and recorded firsthand, so that the route stays open even in winter.

**Fear.** That the survey team's own food runs out, the team turns into a provisions-requisition squad, and the citizenship of restoration labor disappears.

**Intervention.** You can accompany an outer-track survey to help Myeong Soi lay the standard, or leave the provisions-requisition order as evidence to block the vote.

Principled, and hates blanks in a sentence. Never pushes the figures of the clerk who collates the sabotage list through the night out of the ledger.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Skill-point recording
- Rank: Guild member
- Title: Skill-Point Ledger Archivist
**Life.** Born in the 2126 cohort. Raised at the Seoul Station registry office. The post of Skill-Point Ledger Archivist opened through the deletion of a single line in a double ledger.
- Workplace: Guro 2-dong. At Guro 2-dong, Je Haon lays out Kim Nayul's shift and citizenship roster side by side with the skill-point ledger. If a forged seal is found, Je Haon preserves the original column and sends the result of checking it against Jang Useok's standard seal to the duty post that handles Baek On's list.

**Office.** Rank: Guild member. Title: Skill-Point Ledger Archivist. Copies work-crew shifts and skill points onto the public blackboard, and does not enter labor without citizenship registration on the Guild Council's agenda ledger.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, when a forged seal was exposed, burned the copy and guarded the original column. Because of this, the signature for the post of Skill-Point Ledger Archivist entered the ledger.

**Relations.** Bound by a contract fixing Kim Nayul's clerk roster as the ledger; cross-verifies Jang Useok's standard seals against skill points; and supports Baek On's demand for refugee citizenship through records.

**Ambition.** To enter workshop hands' skills and health records in the same ledger, so that injured workers do not lose their work in winter.

**Fear.** That the guard corps imprisons the strike workshops and rewrites the guild roster into a military household register.

**Intervention.** You can protect the skill roster and push the citizenship bill through, or expose the manipulation of the sabotage list and shake the archivist's standing.

Reads the size of a work crew from platform dust, and cannot tolerate orders that push food trains back on account of rank. Fills the blanks in the timetable before people.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Concourse duty
- Rank: Auditor
- Title: Guro Concourse Stationmaster
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Grew up on concourse duty. The post of Guro Concourse Stationmaster opened through a replacement shift after an unexcused absence.
- Work location: Guro 5-dong. At the Guro 5-dong concourse, Byeon Siram puts the tool wagon into the public platform queue. When the food pots and a food train overlap, Byeon Siram splits the winter release slots and hands them to the next window shift, and redirects private favors to public intake.

**Office.** Rank: Auditor. Title: Guro Concourse Stationmaster. Publishes the concourse rations and the release window every day, and attaches munitions wagons only after the release window has closed.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, sent a private favor back and redirected it to the public window. Because of this, the signature for the post of Guro Concourse Stationmaster entered the ledger.

**Relationships.** Puts tool-car goods into the platform queue, keeps the food pots on one side of the concourse, and receives the western food-train detour at Guro.

**Ambition.** To make the Guro concourse the face-to-face window where parts release and food sharing are all recorded under one roof.

**Fear.** That the concourse queue register is quietly altered and a patient who should see the doctor first is pushed to the back of the line.

**Intervention.** Can find replacement heating parts and break the seal, or expose the window collusion ledger and reopen the station lottery.

Reads the vibration of defective wheels with the fingertips, and does not forgive merchants who name a standards seal by the price paid for it. Checks the warehouse seal before a skilled worker's fingers.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Occupation: Pump maintenance
- Rank: Union Member
- Title: Representative of Counterfeit Pump Part Victims
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Grew up at the Sinjeong Rolling Stock Depot. The post of Representative of Counterfeit Pump Part Victims opened through a defect report filed just before a derailment.
- Work location: Guro 2-dong. Jong Maru records the wear surface of the counterfeit pump shaft recovered from the Guro 2-dong generator room against Jang Useok's Repair Standards Ledger. Jong hands Gang Minseo the victim list and the results of the sealed-box inspection, and awaits the same part number confirmed by Ryu Dain of Ttukseom.

**Office.** Rank: Union Member. Title: Representative of Counterfeit Pump Part Victims. Places the victim roster and the recovered parts in the same sealed box, and opens the appraisal only when the labor union and the standards auditor view it at the same time.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, Jong took apart a stalled pump and ground down just one worn shaft to get it running again. Because of this, the signature for the post of Representative of Counterfeit Pump Part Victims was entered in the ledger.

**Relations.** Enters the defect list in Jang Useok's Repair Standards Ledger, presses Gang Minseo's standards unification proposal from the victims' side, and testifies with Ryu Dain of Ttukseom to both ends of the same counterfeit part.

**Ambition.** Posts the manufacturing workshops and distribution routes of defective pump parts to the public ledger, so that repair standards do not become a shield for counterfeit seals.

**Fear.** That a counterfeit packing bursts in a generator fuel pump on a winter night, sparks and heat leak out and draw outside machines, and the accident becomes the pretext for forced mobilization by the munitions work crews.

**Intervention.** Can find the original plate of the counterfeit seal to back a halt to its shipments, or expose evidence that a workshop not on the roster was slipped in.

Stops the pen at blanks in family-unit registration rosters, and underlines at length any sentence that turns skill into military status. Never raises a voice, but leaves the signature line blank.

- Occupation: Testimony recording
- Rank: Union member
- Title: Recovery Service Refusal Testimony Clerk
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Grew up on waiting-hall duty. The post of Recovery Service refusal testimony clerk opened up as a substitute watch for an unexcused shift absence.
- Work location: Guro 2-dong. In Guro 2-dong, Go Morae takes down refusal testimonies against Recovery Service registration beside Kim Nayul's shift roster. Go Morae matches the names on Baek On's family vote against the testimony copies, and if Bae Ujin's side renews the compulsory registration demand, submits to the testimony bench only copies with confirmed joint signatures.

**Office.** Rank: union member. Title: Recovery Service Refusal Testimony Clerk. Records testimony only when the labor union clerk and the civic representative hear it together, and does not file military household register forms even when they are received.

**Anecdote.** In the 2125 station fire, carried out the register of persons first. Because of this, the signature for the post of Recovery Service Refusal Testimony Clerk was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** Shares refusal statements with Kim Nayul's union clerk, supports Baek On's family vote, and blocks Bae Ujin's compulsory registration demand at the testimony bench.

**Ambition.** To leave voluntary adult Recovery Service and civil-rights contracts in the union charter, so that separated family registration cannot pass the Guild Council.

**Fear.** The fear that a refusal testimony will be turned into a deserter list, and that the list will become the grounds for requisition by the Amsa Officer Network.

**Intervention.** Can recover the family register to prove their refusal, or find the person who altered the testimony into a deserter list and replace the clerk.

- Livelihood: Delivering Charter Copies

**Life.** Generation of 2126. Grew up on duty at the Sinnae transfer station. The post of Fabrication Charter Herald opened after she stopped a ticketless departing train.
- Workplace: Guro 5-dong. Yeo Sion first checks the seals and dates on the three copies of the Fabrication Charter to be posted in the alleys of Guro 5-dong. She splits the route with Pyo Gangho's standards courier road and posts Gang Minseo's council declaration, and only then hands the copy of the ratification demand to Yun Seorin.

**Office.** Rank: Union Member. Title: Fabrication Charter Herald. The Labor Union, the Building Union, and the Guard Corps each receive one copy, and a delivery with only one copy left does not depart.

**Anecdote.** In 2125 she cleared a transfer passage blocked by heavy snow and moved the injured first. Because of this, her signature for the post of Fabrication Charter Herald was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** She splits routes with Pyo Gangho's standards courier road, posts Gang Minseo's Guild Council declaration in the Guro alleys, and accepts Yun Seorin's ratification demand only after posting.

**Ambition.** She will post the repair standards and restoration-labor citizenship of the independent charter on the union bulletin boards before Records Office ratification, so that the debt of legitimacy cannot swallow the rules of production.

**Fear.** That the charter copies will be recalled with ratification as bait, and the Guild Council will fall to being a subordinate work crew of Seoul Station politics.

**Intervention.** You can recover the recalled copy and finish the posting, or reveal that the wording on the three copies differs and have the herald replaced.

rules.from:
Counts skilled workers' shift hours before the number of toolboxes, and is wary of anyone who pins the unification proposal's name on as a military ration tag. Speaks of practical gain, but does not pull civilian power into logistics.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Occupation: Waiting-hall duty
- Rank: Guild Member
- Title: Fabrication Logistics Officer
**Life.** Born in the 2126 generation. Grew up on waiting-hall duty. The Fabrication Logistics post opened as a substitute duty after an unexcused shift absence.
- Work location: Guro 3-dong. On the Guro 3-dong logistics blackboard, Gi Pilho first writes down the winter parts needed for civilian power and skilled-worker shifts. If Choe Dain's engineer work crew demands release before the lottery, he waits for the skill scores to be posted and separately seals a parts slot to exchange with Gi Bareum.

**Office.** Rank: Guild Member. Title: Fabrication Logistics Officer. Logistics releases are made only after the Guild Council lottery and the disclosure of skill scores, and the secret munitions compartment is locked along with the power output.

**Anecdote.** Choe Dain's engineer work crew demands logistics release ahead of the Guild Council lottery. Gi Pilho sets the release order only after posting the skill scores, and, keeping the secret munitions compartment locked along with the power output, moves the parts slot to be exchanged with Gi Bareum onto the supply ticket.

**Relations.** Matches the release order of parts crates with the mechanics of the depot workshop, and loads food bins together with market traders.

**Ambition.** To keep the repair-standard unification proposal as a mutual-repair-rights supply ticket rather than a conquest by force, so that the work crews are not turned into nothing but engineer corps.

**Fear.** That the haul carts turn into carts for weapon crates, and that the parts bins become collateral in bargains to swap people.

**Intervention.** Can justify his seal by filling the mutual-repair-rights supplies, or expose the hidden ammunition compartment and have the logistics officer replaced.

- Livelihood: Concourse Watch duty
- Rank: None
- Title: Daechi-Godeok Residents' Representative
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Raised on waiting-hall duty beside the Hwagok underground passage. Gim Doha posts shutter-check results and the number of food bins on the platform wall, and before the night patrol asks neighboring families how much fuel they have left.
- Duty: Daechi 4-dong. Gim Doha posts shutter-check results and the number of food bins on the platform wall, and before the night patrol asks neighboring families how much fuel they have left.
- Duty: Godeok 1-dong. Gim Doha aligns the Godeok Gate evacuation routes with Chae Bom's patrol flags and postpones the decision to open until the residents return.

**Office.** Rank: Ordinary Citizen. Title: Daechi-Godeok Residents' Representative. She posts evacuation passages and shutter-check results publicly, and brings the number of food bins to the residents’ gathering before the number of research personnel.

**Anecdote.** In 2125 he turned away a private solicitation and sent it to the public window.

**Relations.** Shares winter food and fuel with neighboring families, takes turns on check duty, and joins in when a household suffers a kidnapping on the road.

**Ambition.** Aims to let the residents’ gathering set the food and fuel minimum so that, however long the winter runs, the village is not held hostage.

**Fear.** That on the day winter food and fuel run out, neighboring families will be taken hostage in exchange for something to eat.

**Intervention.** He can break the dispatch freeze by arranging a substitute food convoy, or strengthen the residents' veto by uncovering the secret agreement to hand over the register.

She notices the blur of the print on a medicine pouch before the severity of the illness, and regards brokers who call efficacy a "protection fee" as thieves. She hides her anger but does not yield on the sample seal.

- Affiliation: Arc
- Livelihood: Managing drug-harm evidence and victim rolls
- Rank: Ordinary Citizen
- Title: Representative of Victims of Fake Drug Samples
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Grew up at the Jegi-dong infirmary. When appraising the leftover samples from the medicine pouches with Jin Chaeon, Bae Seoyul also checks the seal on the victim roll.
- Duties: Yangjae 2-dong. When appraising the leftover samples from the medicine pouches with Jin Chaeon, Bae Seoyul also checks the seal on the victim roll.
- Duties: Daechi 1-dong. Bae Seoyul matches copies of Daechi's certification stamp against the victims' medicine pouches to find traces of forgery, and does not release samples before they are sealed.

**Office.** Rank: Ordinary Citizen. Title: Representative of Victims of Fake Drug Samples. She double-seals the victim roll and the leftover medicine pouches, and opens appraisal only when the Healing Guild and Safety Review are together in one place.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, during a shortage of medicinal herbs, she halved the prescribed doses and shared them out among everyone.

**Relationships.** She entrusts the samples to Ryu Eunbi's treatment neutrality, demands efficacy verification from Jeong Hojun, and borrows the safety of Jin Chaeon's laboratory building as a place for appraisal.

**Ambition.** She aims to post the fake drugs' manufacturing routes and the Protection Bureau warehouse on the public ledger, so that medicine comes down from the market price of spoils.

**Fear.** That the fake drugs spread among the refugees will be used by forging the Daechi certification stamp, and that technical certification itself will become the packaging of poison.

**Intervention.** She can cross-check Bae Seoyul's victim roll against the seals on the recovered medicine pouches and verify copies bearing the forged stamp.

- Work: Yangjae 1-dong. Before filing a parts-exchange list, Yeo Dasom cross-checks the receiving side's reading order against the wording to make sure no hostage demand is slipped in, and binds a copy of the neighboring settlement's minimum fuel line.

**Office.** Rank: Ordinary Citizen. Title: Consultation Technology-Sharing Clerk. A technology-sharing copy is placed at another participant's seat only after the delegate taking part in the negotiation has read it, and a draft with an empty hostage-substitution field is not filed.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, when the power failed during emergency care, she kept stanching the bleeding under the light of a handheld phone.

**Relations.** As clerk, she copies out the parts lists the maintenance staff need, puts the wording of the exchange termination conditions into the same bundle, and exchanges copies of the minimum fuel line with a neighboring settlement's records keeper.

**Ambition.** Raise verification-data sharing to an independent item of parts exchange, so that the records do not fall to being an appendix of a stronger party's deal.

**Fear.** If the conference collapses, the researcher roster becomes the allocation table for a split submission, and the clerk becomes the handwriting on that table.

She long remembers clans that are bold, quick-fingered, and hide their skill. She hears any talk of filling the Chief Steward's vacant seat by bloodline as an insult to the workshops.

- Affiliation: Arc
- Occupation: Workshop assembly records and shift coordination
- Rank: Ordinary Citizen
- Title: Cheonho Workshop Council Representative
**Life.** Born of the 2126 generation. Han Somi grew up on duty in the waiting hall. She took the post of Cheonho Workshop Council Representative as a substitute on-duty officer for shift no-shows.
- Han Somi's work as Cheonho Workshop Council Representative is connected to Amsa 1-dong.

**Office.** No rank. Title: Cheonho Spare Parts Keeper. She divides the important parts among several households, keeps only the final stock records in one place, and opens an emptied storage box only when several neighbors are present together.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, Han Somi spent the night negotiating terms with the sabotage work crew and got the next shift started. Because of this, her signature for the post of Cheonho Workshop Council Representative was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** She is a rival of Im Chowon over the succession, owes a debt of fair division to the missing Im Hajun, and checks both Bak Serin's clan proxy and Jeong Gaon's testament ledger at once.

**Ambition.** She wants the order of sharing winter spare parts and fuel to be set by the neighbors' agreement, so that no single household or clan can hold the storage box and take other households hostage.

**Fear.** Han Somi fears that, of the three testaments, the clan's will will be ratified as the authentic one, reducing the workshops to subcontractors of a hereditary trade.

**Intervention.** By protecting the assembly records in the workshop vault she can push her joint governance plan, or she can redirect the suspicion of testament forgery toward Im Chowon and bring the representative down.

- Ryu Dain's work as Counterfeit Shutter Motor Parts Victim Artisan is linked to Amsa 1-dong.

**Office.** Rank: Teacher. Title: Counterfeit Shutter Motor Parts Victim Artisan. She keeps recalled parts and the victim register in the same box, and opens appraisals only when an alley-pump mechanic and a council messenger are both present to see them.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, Ryu Dain found three leaking joints during a water-pressure test and posted them on the marker board. Because of this, the signature for the post of Counterfeit Shutter Motor Parts Victim Artisan was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** She bears witness to both ends of the counterfeit parts alongside Jong Maru of Guro, leaves the sweet smell in Heo Gyeom's alley-pump log, and owes a debt for having demanded that Han Somi halt shipments.

**Ambition.** Expose the dispatch workshop behind the counterfeit parts installed in the Amsa pumps, so that the joint maintenance-and-parts standard cannot become a shield for forged seals.

**Fear.** Ryu Dain fears that a counterfeit packing will kill a single pump, and that the Amsa Protection Corps will then station itself in the resulting blackout, disguising its occupation as relief.

**Intervention.** She can recover the forged seal master plate to justify halting his line, or expose whoever slipped an unregistered workshop into the roster, which would isolate the artisan.

Ma Gilsang reads the time from the water temperature of the supply pipes beneath the bridge, and takes no pride in manholes that are not on the map. He regards a late report as a sin.

- Affiliation: Eastern Defense Command
- Livelihood: Bridge Underside Crack and Vibration Survey
- Rank: Guard
- Title: Eastern Bridge Underside Surveyor
Life. Ma Gilsang was born in the 4th generation. Ma Gilsang grew up at the Amsa guard post. Ma Gilsang's post of Eastern Bridge Underside Surveyor opened up after a night-time unauthorized river crossing was caught.
- In duties linked with Amsa 2-dong, Ma Gilsang manages the ledger of water sampling and vibrations under the bridge, and obtains signatures from both the administration and the Blockade Corps for any damage.

**Office.** Rank: Sergeant. Title: Eastern Bridge Underside Surveyor. Records cracks and vibrations in the same ledger, and a damaged section is marked as a hostile act only when Yi Yunseo and Jeong Soyul sign at the same time.

Anecdote. When the initial report turned out wrong in the 2125 bridge assault drill, Ma Gilsang reopened the observation compartment.

**Relations.** Receives orders to hand surveys over to Yi Yunseo's blockade clock, competes with Go Seojun's ridge reconnaissance over passage coordinates, and sends detour dotted lines to Seo Raon's public map by contract.

**Ambition.** Draws the flooded detours of the eastern Han River bridges and the outer approach roads on a single public nautical chart so that the Blockade Corps stops firing by mistake.

Fear. Ma Gilsang fears that the survey routes will be sealed as military secrets and the under-bridge passage map sold as an infiltration route for the Protectorate.

**Intervention.** Can take charge of diving escort to determine the cause of damage, or expose the secret infiltration route markings.

Ju Dana reads part prices faster than the river wind, and immediately strikes merchants who cheat the scales or mix in stolen parts from the morning lottery. She haggles as if singing, but never raises prices in the service alleys.

- Affiliation: Eastern Office
- Livelihood: Checking and recording the condition of exchange parts
- Rank: Guard
- Title: Checker at the Godeok Parts Exchange
Life. Ju Dana was born in 2077. Ju Dana grew up on charging duty at Godeok base. Ju Dana's post as checker at the Godeok parts exchange opened after she filtered out badly conditioned parts on a winter night.
- In work connected with Godeok 1-dong, Ju Dana handles the condition sheets of exchange parts and holds back the release of parts that fall short of standard.

**Office.** Rank: Guard. Title: Godeok Parts Exchange Checker. Before an exchange begins, checks the part condition sheets; parts that fall below standard are not handed out even if a recipient has been decided.

**Anecdote.** On a winter morning, just before the first exchange at the Godeok parts exchange, an offer arrives asking for an urgent price hike. Ju Dana sends the offer back, reads the condition sheets of the parts on the exchange table one by one, and for any part below standard, writes down the recipient's name and then keeps it tied to the storage rack.

**Relations.** She checks the condition sheets of parts from the Free City workshop before exchange, and matches the guard's repair order against Bae Ujin's records.

**Ambition.** She opens part exchanges only together with the records, so that part prices become a public ledger for everyone.

Fear. Ju Dana fears that in a winter short of parts, prices at the Godeok exchange will jump like ration prices and the Eastern Rifle Guard's machine-body repairs will stop.

**Intervention.** You can expose the smuggling winning-bid ledger, or escort the sealed samples to protect her public auction.

- Affiliation: Eastern Defense Command
- Occupation: Emergency generation fuel and output operation
- Rank: Guard Squad Leader
- Title: Godeok Base Emergency Generation Operator
Life. Seol Bomi was born in the 3rd generation. Seol Bomi grew up at the Sinjeong depot. Seol Bomi's post as Godeok Base Emergency Generation Operator opened through a defect report made just before a derailment.
- In work connected with Godeok 2-dong, Seol Bomi manages the emergency generation fuel and output seals and cuts military power distribution if output falls short of the minimum.

**Office.** Rank: Company Commander. Title: Godeok Base Emergency Generation Operator. Every shift, seals the fuel reserve and output log and sends it to Yang Giseok, and cuts military power distribution whenever output falls below the minimum, even when the commander presses.

Anecdote. In 2125, Seol Bomi detected a wheel defect by touch just before a derailment on the siding and stopped the train.

**Relations.** Supports Yang Giseok's siding power allocation from the generation side, matches output to test runs, and has complied with Bae Ujin's public disclosure of restoration results but refused concealed power distribution.

**Ambition.** Binds Godeok emergency generation and Amsa charging power into a single public ledger, so everyone can check the winter fuel share.

Fear. Seol Bomi fears nights when the fuel runs out, machine-body charging cuts off, and a band bent on dragging people away comes in through the gap.

He looks first at the blank cells of the dispatch sheet, and weighs whether the small convoy departs on time rather than the big trains. Even when seated in the arbitration seat, he keeps his voice low.

- Affiliation: The Government
- Rank: Jusa
- Occupation: Receiving and arbitrating written track dispatch objections
- Title: Track Dispatch Arbitrator
**Life.** Born in 2069, Kevin White takes up the duties of Track Dispatch Arbitrator in the opening period of 2126. He grew up on the Sinnae transfer night duty. His work as Track Dispatch Arbitrator began with stopping a ticketless departing train. His African American family line is rooted in the Yongsan–Itaewon living sphere. Samuel White lived through the Great Blackout around 2026 in Yongsan–Itaewon, working in Itaewon lodging and private interpreting. The family passed down records of residences and goods handovers to the next generation, and Kevin White's parents' generation checked those records against the living ledgers of their own time. They speak English at home and Korean in daily life and at work.
- Kevin White's work of receiving and arbitrating written track dispatch objections is linked to Hangangno-dong.

**Office.** Rank: Jusa. Title: Track Dispatch Arbitrator. Dispatch objections are accepted in writing only, and verbal pressure is deferred to the next window.

**Anecdote.** Verbal pressure backed by Bak Taegyeom's mediation proposal enters the arbitration seat and asks for the track keys. Kevin White defers the pressure to the next window, enters only the written objection on the dispatch sheet, and first checks whether the small convoy train departed on time.

**Relations.** Carries Bak Taegyeom's mediation proposal into the field, but does not hand over the track keys.

**Ambition.** To fix track dispatch arbitration not as a three-great-state agreement but as a single timetable of Yongsan Station.

**Fear.** That if a gap opens in arbitration, the Yongsan turnback line will become the waiting queue for the Amsa convoy.

**Intervention.** He can set up an arbitration witness or expose a hidden waiting train.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, sent a box of defective parts back just before shipment. Because of this, the signature for the post of Cheongnyangni Refrigeration Base Supervisor was entered in the ledger.

- Livelihood: Disclosure of remaining stock before food convoy departures

**Life.** Born to the 2126 generation. Grew up at the Jegi-dong infirmary. The Consultative Food Convoy Cargo Owner post opened through a counterfeit-medicine seal.
- Chu Boram handles the disclosure of remaining stock before food convoy departures in Cheongnyangni-dong.

**Office.** Rank: Ordinary Citizen. Title: Consultative Food Convoy Cargo Owner. Discloses remaining stock at departure and suspends the Council platform privileges of cargo owners with piled-up unredeemed tickets.

**Anecdote.** When the power went out during emergency care in 2125, she kept stanching the bleeding by the light of a mobile phone. Because of this, her signature for the Consultative Food Convoy Cargo Owner post was entered in the ledger.

**Relations.** Filters O Doyun's Chamber Regulation tickets out of the Council convoy, attaches a food compartment to Jeong Yura's Joint Negotiation envoy, and reviews Jang Sehwa's draft of the Mutual Convoy at the berth.

**Ambition.** Binds the Council's food convoy to the practical work of the Mutual Convoy treaty rather than to cargo owner shares, so that Cheongnyangni does not become a yard of partitioned subjugation.

**Fear.** That once rail unloading and food handover within Seoul are cut off, false-inventory tickets will exceed the actual remaining stock and destroy the convoy train and its settlement credit.

rules.from:
Counts the food portions and heating fuel for the people in the cells exactly, like a scale, every day, and recounts in silence when a number is off. Says little; her dates are exact.

- Affiliation: The Government
- Rank: Ordinary Citizen
- Livelihood: Holding-cell fuel and food counts
- Title: Cheongnyangni Station Holding Cell Attendant
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Raised in the duty room beside the Cheongnyangni Station holding cells. The post of holding cell attendant passed to her at a midwinter duty rotation.
- Eo Doyun handles checks of heating fuel and food counts for the holding cells in Cheongnyangni-dong.

**Office.** Rank: Ordinary Citizen. Title: Holding Cell Attendant of the Cheongnyangni Station. Checks the cell shutters and heating, rewrites the food and fuel counts on the wall, and gets two duty staff to confirm any change.

**Anecdote.** On a night of bitter cold the fuel for the cell stoves falls short of the number of cells left. Eo Doyun rewrites the food and fuel counts on the wall board and checks cell by cell with two duty staff. She hands out blankets and moves anyone whose body temperature is dropping to the upper room first.

**Relationships.** Reads the board numbers together with the relieving duty staff of the same station and remembers exactly when each escorted person was received.

**Ambition.** To post the cells' food and fuel counts openly on the wall so that when the numbers shrink in winter, anyone can tell whose share was cut first.

**Fear.** That in a cold snap the fuel will run out and the people in the cells will freeze, and that leaking light will draw outside machines into the station.

**Intervention.** Can recover a cut memory phrase, or escort a witness to the public-right interpretation.

- Affiliation: Free City

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Currency Appraisal Archivist and Hwang Eunseol's working-level aide. If there are fewer than two independent testimonies, suspends transcription and posts the reason for the suspension on the repository door the same day.

Listens to counterfeit engravings before people's words, and tries to tell with the same hand when silence saves a life and when it covers up a fact. Skeptical, and reads each sentence twice.

- Rank: Clerk
- Title: Counterfeit Currency Internal Informant
**Life.** Born 2069-06-19; the approved birth cohort is Cohort 3. Active at the 2126 opening. Raised on the Yeouido Vault night watch. The post of Counterfeit Currency Internal Informant opened through keeping the vault going during the three-day blackout.
- Ran Se-on uses Yeouidong as a workplace district and handles the cross-checking of internal records and testimony on counterfeit currency.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Counterfeit Currency Internal Informant. Hands copies of the records to the appraisers and the Investment Council at the same time, and does not post a solo exposure on the bulletin board before two testimonies are gathered.

**Anecdote.** When an altered ledger was found among the Three Wills of Spring, Ran Se-on posted the internal records of the counterfeit currency on the door of the Clerks' Office.

**Relationships.** Tests Choe Jiu's common currency from the inside, attaches blank entries to Hwang Eunseol's pending ledger, and matches Hong Yejun's will verification with the engravings.

**Ambition.** Discloses the internal records before the counterfeit currency goes out through official counters, so that the common currency does not become the victor's certificate.

**Fear.** That a single line of tip-off will turn into a censorship roster and that they will become the hand that stops the common currency from within.

**Intervention.** Can escort the informant, or delay the records by a day to prevent a riot at the cost of leaving the risk of exposure.

Reads the night cold by the length of the line at the stoves, and records any moment when a stove goes out for lack of fuel as the station's failure. A shutter order passed on by word of mouth is not written on the check sheet.

- Occupation: Shutter checks and fuel counting
- Affiliation: Arc
- Rank: Stationmaster
- Title: Stationmaster of Seocho 1-, 3- and 4-dong, in Charge of Shutters and Fuel
**Life.** Raised on the Seocho 1-dong tunnel patrol watch. He now serves as stationmaster of the three stations Seocho 1-, 3- and 4-dong, keeping the shutters and the fuel ledger.
- Mobok handles shutter checks and fuel counting in Seocho 1-, 3- and 4-dong. Every day he checks the shutter latches and heat screens, counts the fuel drums and enters them in the ledger together with the patrol shift table. Personal residence or lodging ownership is not presumed. He gathers the reports of the three dong patrol crews into one ledger

**Office.** Rank: Stationmaster. Title: Stationmaster of Seocho 1-, 3- and 4-dong in charge of shutters and fuel. When the temperature gauge touches its lowest mark, he turns down the stoves and lowers the shutters, and permits the next entry only after the heat screen is covered again.

**Anecdote.** When only the paper saying northern piping pressure had dropped arrived first, Mobok split the bucket line in two and did not write the succession-test postponement on the hub wall.

**Relations.** Gathers the reports of the Seocho 1-, 3- and 4-dong patrol crews into one ledger, and hangs the fuel drum count and the patrol shift table on the same nail. When the family of someone captured outside comes, he checks their food share first.

**Ambition.** Turn the hub valve only at the same time as the Chairman's Office posting, before the bucket line scatters.

**Fear.** That the hub valve will be tied to the succession-test schedule, and the handle pulled off, paint and all, before the residence kettles go cold.

**Intervention.** Can obtain a spare shutter latch so the door can be closed again, or identify whoever removed the heat screen and change the duty roster.

- Affiliation: Arc
- Rank: Ordinary Citizen

**Life.** Grew up on the Seocho 1-dong tunnel track maintenance watch. The work of verifying wheel intake and release at Seocho 1-dong grew out of a habit of saving worn parts.
Sun Hajun handles wheel intake-weight and dispatch testimony work in Yeoksam 1-dong. He organizes the samples, weights, lots, measurements, work crews, and accident signatures for salvaged wheels and parts within the Yeoksam 1-dong work-living area adjacent to Gangnam Station. The cargo handover at the Yeoksam waiting hall is for reference only and does not confirm actual factory equipment, warehouse monopolies, or running trains. He overlays the weight logged on Hwang Noeul's salvage scales with the intake weight, points to the same box as Chu Hangyeol's Yongsan handover testimony, and witnesses the dispatch of the parts column Im Hajun guaranteed toward the Arc machine bodies.

**Office.** Rank: Ordinary Citizen. Title: Arc Wheel Exchange Witness. Two witnesses check the intake weight, and a release slip whose weight does not match is not sent out before the ledger is straightened out.

**Anecdote.** In the week the first cold wave hit, Sun Hajun placed the worn-out wheels and brake box on the scale, checked their weight and left a replacement mark.

**Relationships.** He overlays the weight logged on Hwang Noeul's salvage scales with the intake weight, points to the same box as Chu Hangyeol's Yongsan handover testimony, and witnesses the dispatch of the parts column Im Hajun guaranteed toward the Arc machine bodies.

**Ambition.** To leave the cart parts exchange in an inventory ledger that everyone can read, so that no particular work crew can hold parts hostage and shake fuel and food transport.

**Fear.** That after the guarantor disappears, the exchange testimony will be cited only as grounds for military-exclusive dispatch.

If a message is late in the frozen passage, he does not hide the receipt time but writes it in the next shift ledger and passes it on to his successor.

**Office.** Rank: Union Member. Title: Work Crew Courier. If a message is late in the frozen passage, he does not hide the receipt time but writes it in the next shift ledger and passes it on to his successor.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, upon receiving a report that the sleepers had sunk from a leak beneath the frozen track in Oryu 2-dong, he immediately closed the dispatch section. Because of this, the signature for the Work Crew Courier post was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** Bak Doyun is Lee Ilseop's direct courier, in charge of delivering messages and confirming receipt.

Louis Lefebvre went through the Great Blackout in Itaewon, Yongsan around 2026, working in private warehousing and electrical repair in Yongsan. The family passed its records of lodgings and goods handovers down to the next generation, and Antoine Lefebvre's parents' generation checked those records against the living ledgers of their day. They speak French at home and Korean in daily life and at work.

- Title: Escort Courier
**Life.** Isabel Garcia, born in 2098, takes up the Escort Courier duties in the opening period of 2126. She grew up on the duty shift at the Sinnae transfer station. The Escort Courier work began with her stopping a ticketless train departure. Her Spanish-descended family has roots in the Yongsan and Itaewon neighborhoods. Manuel Garcia lived through the Great Blackout in Yongsan and Itaewon around 2026, working in private food supply in Itaewon and in transport in Yongsan. The family passed its shelter and goods handover records to the next generation, and Isabel Garcia's parents' generation cross-checked those records against the living ledgers of their time. They speak Spanish at home and Korean in daily life and at work.
- Isabel Garcia's work on ticketless train departures and signature checks is tied to Hangang-ro-dong.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Escort Courier. She hands over only the keys and records of her own post, and does not invent authority she does not have.

**Anecdote.** In 2125 she stopped a train with no dispatch sheet and blocked an unsigned departure. Because of that act, the Escort Courier post's signature was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** Isabel Garcia reports unsigned train departures to Eva Novakova. Eva Novakova checks the occupancy window and the boarding proof, and does not record a run with no departure handover as a completed run.

**Ambition.** To keep complete records of the escort cargo count's fuel and food load quantities and signatures, so that the next duty officer checks the same records.

**Fear.** That if the escort cargo count duty shift goes empty, fuel and food will leave Yongsan Station with wrong counts, and shortfalls will be passed on as unverified completion records.

**Intervention.** You can bring in a witness for the duty handover or expose the empty key.

rules.from:
Seong Rahyeon resolves not to announce that the detour is open until the ties have been checked.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Transfer message delivery
- Rank: Guild Member
- Title: Work Crew Courier
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Raised at the Sinnae transfer watch. The post of Work Crew Courier opened through stopping a ticketless departing train.
- Duty location: Guro 5-dong. Seong Rahyeon attaches a closure note for the flooded track to the work crew's message bound for the Guro 5-dong council. Informs Byeon Siram of the time the collapse report was received and entrusts confirmation of resumed dispatch to the next courier.

**Office.** Rank: Guild Member. Title: Work Crew Courier. Informs Byeon Siram of the time the collapse report was received and entrusts confirmation of resumed dispatch to the next courier.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, upon receiving a report that a railroad tie had sunk because of a leak beneath the frozen track at Guro 5-dong, the dispatch section was closed at once. Because of this, a signature for the post of Work Crew Courier was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** Seong Rahyeon tells Myeong Soi where messages have stopped because of the flood closure. Myeong Soi surveys the tracks and ties to confirm whether a detour is possible and keeps work crews from taking unverified routes.

**Ambition.** Seong Rahyeon strives to pass along the flood closure note and the report time without omission, so that no work crew message departs onto an unverified track.

**Fear.** That Myeong Soi sends messages from the flooded section by a detour before checking the ties, so that a work crew enters an unverified track.

**Intervention.** The player can cross-check the collapse report time with Seong Rahyeon and deliver the closure note to Byeon Siram, or wait for the next courier's confirmation that dispatch has resumed.
